shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "git status --short && sed -n '1,260p' src/components/LightboxRoot.tsx && printf '\\n--- RTL tests ---\\n' && sed -n '1,280p' test/unit/RTL.spec.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'mempal search "yet-another-react-lightbox RTL direction getComputedStyle root component" --json --top-k 5'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' src/hooks/index.ts && rg \"export function useForkRef|useForkRef\" src/hooks src -g '*.ts' -g '*.tsx' && sed -n '1,240p' test/unit/test-utils.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "pwd; git rev-parse --show-toplevel; git status --short --untracked-files=all | head -80; rg \"useEffect|useLayoutEffect|detectRTL|RTLContextProvider|useRTL\" src test -g '*.tsx' -g '*.ts'"

/bin/bash -lc "git ls-files | head -40; git status --short -- src/components/LightboxRoot.tsx test/unit/RTL.spec.ts package.json; sed -n '1,160p' src/hooks/useLayoutEffect.ts; sed -n '1,160p' src/hooks/useForkRef.ts; sed -n '1,160p' src/contexts/RTLContext.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'git show --stat --oneline HEAD; git log --oneline -8; git show 506168e:src/components/LightboxRoot.tsx 2>/dev/null || true'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' src/modules/Portal.tsx; sed -n '1,220p' src/modules/Root.tsx 2>/dev/null || true; rg \"function Root|RootModule|LightboxRoot\" src/modules -n"

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p "$HOME/.mempal-notes"; cat > "$HOME/.mempal-notes/react-computed-style-ancestor-state.md" <<'"'EOF'
# Recheck computed styles when ancestor state can change

A component that derives behavior from "'`getComputedStyle` on its mounted element must re-read that style when the component re-renders if ancestor props such as `dir` can change in place. A ref callback only covers attachment and misses updates to inherited CSS state; an SSR-safe layout effect without a dependency array keeps the derived context current during the mount.
EOF
mempal ingest "$HOME/.mempal-notes" --wing memory-evals
git status --short --untracked-files=all | head -100
git diff --stat
git diff --check'
